evals.prompt: Haz una revisión de calidad completa de los cambios de esta rama (todo evals/inputs/branch-discounts/src: añade descuentos por cupón y fidelidad). Es un fixture sin git. Solo revisión: no modifiques nada.
evals.expected_output: A single report with the verdict 'Changes required'. It runs the tests (3/3 pass) and says so. Prioritized findings with file:line: Critical: SQL injection by interpolation in api/orders.ts (orderId and coupon). Important: the coupon and loyalty logic in pricing.ts has no tests (the 3 existing ones pass without exercising it); a useEffect copying derived state in CartSummary.tsx; a div with onClick that cannot be operated by keyboard. Minor: 0.15 and the threshold 3 as magic numbers. No duplicating the same problem from several lenses, a fix plan grouped by owning skill, and no files modified. It skips design-patterns and solid-principles with a justification, or applies them proportionately. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Runs the tests and reports the real result (3/3)
Explicit overall verdict (Changes required or equivalent)
Marks the SQL injection in api/orders.ts as critical
Points out that the coupon/loyalty logic has no tests that exercise it
Points out the useEffect copying derived state in CartSummary.tsx
Points out the div with onClick that is not keyboard accessible
Points out the magic numbers (0.15 / 3) as a minor finding
Each finding cites file:line and is sorted by severity
Does not repeat the same problem as separate findings from several lenses
Includes a fix plan grouped by skill and asks what to apply
Does not modify any project file
States what it could not verify (browser, real accessibility) or the pre-existing scope
Replies in Spanish

evals.prompt: Do a full quality review of this branch (evals/inputs/tiny-change). The only change fixes a typo in a message in src/greeting.ts. Review only.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate review: it runs the tests (2/2), notes that the change is trivial and the code is already clean, and concludes 'Ready for PR' with no relevant findings. It does not trigger the frontend/backend lenses or propose patterns, layers or refactors. Any suggestion is optional and brief. It does not modify files.
assertions: Runs the tests and reports the real result (2/2)
Verdict 'Ready for PR' or equivalent
States that there are no relevant findings
Does not propose patterns, layers, abstractions or refactors
Says which lenses are skipped and why (or that the change is trivial)
Any suggested improvement is optional and minor
Does not modify any project file
